§ 01 · The Program

A complete
portfolio.

From foundational B1 retail vocabulary to advanced C1 omnichannel and merchandising discourse, every module is anchored in real-world retail scenarios — from store operations to e-commerce, from inventory management to customer loyalty. Built for use inside department stores, specialty boutiques, e-commerce platforms, and retail chains.

01

Industry-anchored

Every question reflects real terminology from sales floors, distribution centers, and e-commerce platforms in 2026.

AI-powered personalization, smart inventory, and contactless checkout run throughout the program — reflecting today's retail industry.
